facts.text: Undergraduates pay a flat tuition fee that covers up to 40 credit hours across fall, spring, and intersessions.

sources.title: Cost of Attendance for Undergraduate Students | IU Bloomington
sources.quote: At IU Bloomington, you'll pay a flat fee for tuition. This means you will be able to take advantage of 40 credit hours across fall, spring, and our intersessions—for the same cost.
